curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Start with the co-signer and affidavit every applicant under eighteen needs, then the alcohol revocations, the offenses that suspend or delay a license, and the adult DUI penalties for young first offenders.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per penalty; a contrast card separating the low-alcohol revocation from a first DUI offense.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming an offense and asking for the penalty or its length.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the attendance form for permit applicants, the driver education certificate and experience log, the two practice-hour paths, and the six crash-free months before a license.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each form and hour rule; a contrast card for the fifty-hour standard path versus the one-hundred-hour remote path.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on which form or how many practice hours a teen needs.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover how to get a permit, how long it lasts, who must supervise, then the six-month permit hold, the passenger limit and the curfew for new teen drivers.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for permit rules and teen limits; contrast cards for car versus motorcycle supervision and for the three six-month rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a teen driver and asking whether a trip or passenger is allowed.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the tests every class needs, what Class C covers and may tow, the other classes, restriction codes, endorsements including the J endorsement, and the motorcycle permit and license rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each class, code and endorsement; contrast cards for Class A versus B versus C and for Class C towing versus the J endorsement.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a vehicle or code and asking which class or meaning applies.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Show who is responsible for renewing, what renewal may test, the military renewal rule, the thirty-day change-reporting rule and how changes are made, duplicate licenses, and restricted licenses.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for renewal and change rules; a contrast card for a restricted license versus an instruction permit.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on deadlines and methods for renewing, replacing or updating a license.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover Nevada ID cards and what issuing one surrenders, the veteran, medical and organ donor designations, the trafficking warning signs, and the license, permit and reinstatement fees.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for ID card rules, designations and fees; contrast cards for standard versus limited-term ID expiry and for age-based fees.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on ID card rules and on which fee applies to a described case.
